program_objective: Improve reproducibility, outcome quality, simplification, delay-cost awareness, confidence calibration, incremental attribution, lineage, reliability, specification quality, external-claim calibration, error learning and temporal coherence of the existing framework without expanding market semantics.

T01_DECISION_REPRODUCIBILITY.goal: Verify exact action-class reproducibility from identical frozen packets and define allowed non-semantic wording variance.
T01_DECISION_REPRODUCIBILITY.primary_risk: Model variance masquerading as market information

T02_CENSORING_OUTCOME_QUALITY.goal: Separate necessary censoring from avoidable censoring caused by data, maturity, lineage or specification defects.
T02_CENSORING_OUTCOME_QUALITY.primary_risk: Valid learning signal discarded or censored for remediable reasons

T03_SIMPLIFICATION_RETIREMENT.goal: Merge, retire or contain redundant/inconclusive existing candidates while preserving evidence history.

T04_DELAY_COST_EXISTING_CONFIRMATION.goal: Measure whether extra confirmation improves decisions after explicitly accounting for delay cost.
T04_DELAY_COST_EXISTING_CONFIRMATION.initial_state: T6 and T8 lack sufficient forward outcomes
T04_DELAY_COST_EXISTING_CONFIRMATION.primary_risk: Late confirmation appearing falsely superior because timing cost is ignored

T05_CONFIDENCE_CALIBRATION.existing_owner: Existing forecast / Director / Action Compass confidence fields
T05_CONFIDENCE_CALIBRATION.goal: Determine whether LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH confidence labels are empirically ordered and decision-useful.
T05_CONFIDENCE_CALIBRATION.initial_state: Labels exist across outputs; unified realized calibration not established

T06_INCREMENTAL_VALUE_COMPRESSION.existing_owner: Sensor Relationship, Survival and Incremental Value standard
T06_INCREMENTAL_VALUE_COMPRESSION.goal: Identify redundant confirmation and retain unique incremental information from existing sensor families.
T06_INCREMENTAL_VALUE_COMPRESSION.initial_state: Methodology exists; forward relationship evidence remains incomplete
T06_INCREMENTAL_VALUE_COMPRESSION.primary_risk: Correlated signals double-counted as independent conviction

T07_LINEAGE_INTEGRITY.goal: Trace every official scored forecast from frozen source through ratification, handoff, verified actual and score.
T07_LINEAGE_INTEGRITY.initial_state: Known W28 source-chain gap plus forward lineage monitoring
T07_LINEAGE_INTEGRITY.primary_risk: Learning from a score whose causal source packet is not reproducible

T08_DAILY_DIRECTOR_RELIABILITY.existing_owner: Daily Director shadow workflow and API task registry
T08_DAILY_DIRECTOR_RELIABILITY.goal: Make existing Director production deterministic, schema-valid, fresh and fail-explicit before increasing intelligence.
T08_DAILY_DIRECTOR_RELIABILITY.initial_state: Architecture health recently AMBER with stale/invalid Director output
T08_DAILY_DIRECTOR_RELIABILITY.primary_risk: Sophisticated prompt with unreliable production continuity

T09_PULLBACK_REPRODUCIBILITY.goal: Either make existing guidance independently reproducible or explicitly constrain it to guidance-only behavior.
T09_PULLBACK_REPRODUCIBILITY.primary_risk: Ambiguous pseudo-rule interpreted differently by agents

T10_TECHDEV_CLAIM_CALIBRATION.goal: Freeze category-specific actuals/scoring and score existing source-backed claims without mixing roadmap, timing, range, trade or discretionary override classes.
T10_TECHDEV_CLAIM_CALIBRATION.initial_state: 186 source-backed claims, zero scored outcome rows at latest registry read
T10_TECHDEV_CLAIM_CALIBRATION.primary_risk: Large external evidence archive remains anecdotal rather than calibrated

T11_FORECAST_ERROR_TAXONOMY.goal: Classify how a forecast failed or succeeded without collapsing direction, magnitude, timing, sequence, phase and action-translation errors.
T11_FORECAST_ERROR_TAXONOMY.initial_state: Partial failure labels exist in multiple owners but unified taxonomy is incomplete
T11_FORECAST_ERROR_TAXONOMY.primary_risk: Hit/miss metrics fail to identify what actually needs improvement

T12_TEMPORAL_ALIGNMENT.existing_owner: Existing owner captures / context routing / Director input builder
T12_TEMPORAL_ALIGNMENT.goal: Quantify and reduce as-of mismatches between evidence compared in the same decision packet.
T12_TEMPORAL_ALIGNMENT.initial_state: Owner freshness varies materially across captures
T12_TEMPORAL_ALIGNMENT.primary_risk: Artificial conflicts caused by comparing different market time slices

global_forbidden_changes: promotion from source rows without matured outcomes
